pairs.name: Brie + Fig Jam
pairs.why: Sweet, dense jam against mild, salty cream. The pairing most people try first, for good reason.

pairs.name: Manchego + Membrillo
pairs.why: Spain's nutty sheep's cheese with its own quince paste. Firm and sweet, salty and floral.

pairs.name: Prosciutto + Melon
pairs.why: Salt makes the melon sweeter; the melon's water makes the ham taste silkier.

pairs.name: Parmigiano + Balsamic
pairs.why: Two products of Emilia-Romagna: salty crystals and sweet-tart glaze.

pairs.name: Gorgonzola + Fig Jam
pairs.why: Sweet jam rounds off blue cheese's sharp, salty edge.

pairs.name: Stilton + Walnuts
pairs.why: Crunchy, slightly bitter walnuts against rich, crumbly blue.

pairs.name: Aged Cheddar + Apple
pairs.why: Crisp, tart apple cuts the fat of a sharp cheddar and resets your palate.

pairs.name: Burrata + Prosciutto
pairs.why: Cool, milky cream against salty, silky ham.

pairs.name: Chorizo + Manchego
pairs.why: The Spanish tapas pair: smoky paprika pork and nutty sheep's cheese.

pairs.name: Goat Cheese + Honey
pairs.why: Honey softens chèvre's tang; the tang keeps honey from tasting cloying.

pairs.name: Mortadella + Pistachios
pairs.why: Bologna's silky sausage already has pistachios inside. Serve extra on the side.

pairs.name: Pecorino + Honey
pairs.why: Sharp, salty sheep's cheese with a drizzle of honey. A Roman after-dinner classic.

trios.name: Brie + Fig Jam + Walnuts
trios.why: Creamy, sweet and crunchy in one bite. The walnut adds the texture brie lacks.

trios.name: Gorgonzola + Pear + Walnuts
trios.why: Juicy pear cools the blue, walnuts add crunch and a bitter edge.

trios.name: Prosciutto + Melon + Mint
trios.why: Mint adds a cool, bright top note to the salt-sweet classic.

trios.name: Smoked Salmon + Cream Cheese + Capers
trios.why: Smoke, cream and brine: the bagel-shop trio.

trios.name: Comté + Pear + Walnuts
trios.why: Nutty cheese, nutty walnut, and pear to keep it fresh.

trios.name: Manchego + Chorizo + Marcona Almonds
trios.why: A tapas bar in three bites: nutty, smoky and salty-crunchy.

trios.name: Goat Cheese + Honey + Pistachios
trios.why: Tangy, sweet and crunchy, with a green-and-gold look that photographs well.

trios.name: Aged Gouda + Dark Chocolate + Sea Salt
trios.why: Caramel crystals, bitter cocoa and a pinch of salt: a dessert board in one bite.

quartets.name: Burrata + Prosciutto + Basil + Olive Oil
quartets.why: An Italian summer plate: cream, salt, herb and a peppery finish.

quartets.name: The Spanish Four
quartets.why: Nutty cheese, smoky pork, sweet quince and salty almonds. Every Spanish tapas flavor on one cracker.

quartets.name: The Bagel Board Four
quartets.why: Smoke, cream, brine and sharp pickled onion. Put it on a bagel chip.

quartets.name: Brie + Pear + Honey + Walnuts
quartets.why: Soft, juicy, sweet and crunchy: four textures that make mild brie taste bigger.

quartets.name: The French Ham & Cheese
quartets.why: Nutty Gruyère, sweet ham, sour cornichons and sharp Dijon: a croque-monsieur without the bread.

quartets.name: Goat Cheese + Fig + Honey + Pistachio
quartets.why: Tangy, jammy, sweet and crunchy. The prettiest bite on a fall board.
